21: 1.2 The terms of each Confirmation relating to a Transaction are hereby incorporated by reference into, and shall be supplemental to and form part of, this Agreement. Each Confirmation shall be read and construed together with this Agreement as a single instrument.
22: 
23: 1.3 In the event of any inconsistency between the terms of any Confirmation, Annex II (Elections and Variables), Annex I (Supplemental Terms and Conditions), and the printed paragraphs of this Agreement, the following order of precedence shall apply:
24: 
25: > \(a\) first, the terms of the relevant Confirmation;
26: >
27: > \(b\) second, the terms of Annex II (Elections and Variables);
28: >
29: > \(c\) third, the terms of Annex I (Supplemental Terms and Conditions); and
30: >
31: > \(d\) fourth, the printed paragraphs of this Agreement.
32: 
33: 1.4 Nothing in this Agreement shall require either party to enter into any Transaction with the other party. Each Transaction shall be entered into on such terms as the parties may agree at the time.
34: 
35: **[Paragraph 2 --- Definitions]{.underline}**
36: 
37: 2.1 In this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:
38: 
39: **\"Act of Insolvency\"** means, in respect of either party, any of the following:
40: 
41: > \(a\) the filing by such party of a petition or the commencement of any case or proceeding under any bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganisation, administration, moratorium, composition, adjustment of debts, liquidation, dissolution, winding-up, or similar law of any jurisdiction, whether now or hereafter in effect, seeking the entry of an order for relief or the adjudication of such party as bankrupt or insolvent, or seeking reorganisation, arrangement, adjustment, winding-up, liquidation, dissolution, composition, or other relief with respect to such party or its debts;
42: >
43: > \(b\) the filing of any such petition or the commencement of any such case or proceeding against such party that (i) results in a judgment of insolvency or bankruptcy, the entry of an order for relief, or the making of an order for the winding-up or liquidation of such party, or (ii) is not dismissed, discharged, stayed, or restrained within the period specified in Annex II, or, if no such period is specified, within thirty (30) calendar days of the institution or presentation thereof;
44: >
45: > \(c\) the seeking by such party of the appointment of an administrator, provisional liquidator, conservator, receiver, trustee, custodian, or other similar official for such party or for all or substantially all of its assets;
46: >
47: > \(d\) the appointment of an administrator, provisional liquidator, conservator, receiver, trustee, custodian, or other similar official for such party or for all or substantially all of its assets;
48: >
49: > \(e\) the making by such party of a general assignment, arrangement, scheme, or composition with or for the benefit of its creditors;
50: >
51: > \(f\) the admission by such party, in writing or otherwise, of its inability to pay its debts as they become due or as they fall due;
52: >
53: > \(g\) the taking of any corporate action, the passing of any resolution, or the making of any application to a court of competent jurisdiction by such party for the purpose of effecting or seeking any of the foregoing;
54: >
55: > \(h\) the imposition by any governmental, regulatory, or supervisory authority of a moratorium with respect to payments by such party; or
56: >
57: > \(i\) any analogous event or proceeding in any jurisdiction.
58: 
59: **\"Agency Transaction\"** means a Transaction entered into by a party acting as agent on behalf of one or more identified or unidentified principals, subject to the provisions of Part 2 of Annex I (Agency Transactions) and the elections made in Annex II.
60: 
61: **\"Appropriate Market\"** means, in relation to any Securities, a market determined in accordance with prevailing market practice for securities of the same type, currency of denomination, and characteristics as the relevant Securities.
62: 
63: **\"Base Currency\"** means the currency specified as such in Part 1 of Annex II.
64: 
65: **\"Business Day\"** means a day (other than a Saturday or Sunday) on which commercial banks and foreign exchange markets are open for general business (including dealings in foreign exchange and foreign currency deposits) in the place or places specified in Annex II as relevant to the performance of the relevant obligation, or, if no such place is specified, in the place or places relevant to the settlement of the relevant Transaction as determined in accordance with market practice.
66: 
67: **\"Buy/Sell Back Transaction\"** means a Transaction of the type described in, and which is subject to, the provisions of Part 1 of Annex I (Buy/Sell Back Transactions) applicable thereto.
68: 
69: **\"Cash Equivalent Investments\"** means investments in such instruments as may be specified or defined in Annex II, or, if no such instruments are specified or defined, investments in overnight deposits in the Base Currency with creditworthy deposit-taking institutions.
70: 
71: **\"Cash Margin\"** means cash transferred as margin pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 4.
72: 
73: **\"Close-out Date\"** means the date designated as such in a Default Notice, being the date on which all outstanding Transactions between the parties are terminated following the occurrence of an Event of Default, or, in the case of automatic Early Termination upon an Act of Insolvency, the date on which such termination occurs automatically.
74: 
75: **\"Confirmation\"** means the written confirmation, the exchange of electronic messages, or other agreed form of communication evidencing the agreement of the parties to the terms of a Transaction, and setting out the specific terms of such Transaction.
76: 
77: **\"Contractual Currency\"** means, in respect of any payment obligation arising under this Agreement or any Transaction, the currency in which such payment is denominated or otherwise required to be made.
78: 
79: **\"Default Market Value\"** means, in respect of any Equivalent Securities or Purchased Securities that are the subject of a terminated Transaction, the market value of such securities determined in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 10.
80: 
81: **\"Default Notice\"** means a notice served by the Non-Defaulting Party pursuant to Paragraph 10, designating that an Event of Default has occurred and specifying a Close-out Date.
82: 
83: **\"Defaulting Party\"** means the party in respect of which an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.
84: 
85: **\"Deliverable Securities\"** means the Securities to be delivered by Seller to Buyer on the Purchase Date of a Transaction.
86: 
87: **\"Distributions\"** means all dividends, interest payments, principal repayments, redemption proceeds, and any other payments, distributions, or deliveries of any kind whatsoever paid, made, or received in respect of Securities, whether in cash, in kind, or otherwise, including, without limitation, any rights, warrants, or other entitlements arising in respect of such Securities.
88: 
89: **\"Equivalent Margin Securities\"** means securities equivalent to Margin Securities previously transferred pursuant to Paragraph 4, being securities of the same issuer, part of the same issue, and of an identical type, nominal value, description, and amount as the relevant Margin Securities.
90: 
91: **\"Equivalent Securities\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, securities equivalent to the Purchased Securities under that Transaction. Securities are \"equivalent to\" other securities for these purposes if they are: (a) of the same issuer; (b) part of the same issue; (c) of an identical type, nominal value, description, and amount; and (d) equivalent in all material respects. Where Purchased Securities have been redeemed, converted, exchanged, or subdivided, or any rights, warrants, or other entitlements have arisen in respect thereof, \"Equivalent Securities\" shall include, as appropriate, the resulting securities, rights, entitlements, and proceeds.
92: 
93: **\"Event of Default\"** means any of the events specified in Paragraph 10(a).
94: 
95: **\"Income\"** means any Distributions in the form of dividends, interest, or other periodic payments in respect of any Purchased Securities during the Term of a Transaction, but shall not include any redemption proceeds or principal repayments, unless otherwise agreed in Annex II.
96: 
97: **\"Income Payment Date\"** means, in respect of any Purchased Securities, the date on which Income is paid or distributed in respect of such Securities by the issuer or relevant paying agent.
98: 
99: **\"ICMA\"** means the International Capital Market Association.
100: 
101: **\"Margin Percentage\"** means the percentage agreed between the parties in relation to a Transaction, or, if no such percentage is agreed, the percentage specified in Annex II for the relevant category of Purchased Securities.
102: 
103: **\"Margin Ratio\"** means the ratio agreed between the parties in relation to a Transaction, or, if no such ratio is agreed, the ratio specified in Annex II for the relevant category of Purchased Securities.
104: 
105: **\"Margin Securities\"** means Securities transferred by way of margin pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 4.
106: 
107: **\"Margin Transfer\"** means any transfer of Cash Margin or Margin Securities pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 4.
108: 
109: **\"Market Value\"** means, in respect of any Securities on any particular date, the price obtained from a generally recognised pricing source in the Appropriate Market for securities of the same description, or, if no such price is available, the most recently available closing bid price quotation from such source. If no such pricing source or quotation is available, Market Value shall be determined in good faith by the parties having regard to prevailing market conditions and the characteristics of the relevant Securities, and, in the event of disagreement, as determined in accordance with Paragraph 4(h).
110: 
111: **\"Net Exposure\"** has the meaning given to it in Paragraph 4(b).
112: 
113: **\"Net Margin\"** has the meaning given to it in Paragraph 4.
114: 
115: **\"Net Paying Party\"** means the party that, following the close-out calculation under Paragraph 10, has a net obligation to make payment to the other party.
116: 
117: **\"Net Value of Margin Provided\"** means, in respect of any party, the aggregate Market Value of all Margin Securities transferred by that party to the other party and not yet returned, plus the aggregate amount of all Cash Margin transferred by that party to the other party and not yet returned, less the aggregate Market Value of all Equivalent Margin Securities returned to that party and less the aggregate amount of all Cash Margin returned to that party.
118: 
119: **\"New Purchased Securities\"** means securities substituted for original Purchased Securities in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 8.
120: 
121: **\"Non-Defaulting Party\"** means the party that is not the Defaulting Party.
122: 
123: **\"Price Differential\"** means, in respect of any Transaction and as at any date, the aggregate amount of interest that has accrued on the Purchase Price from (and including) the Purchase Date to (but excluding) the date of calculation, computed on the basis of the Pricing Rate agreed for that Transaction and the day count convention applicable to such Pricing Rate.
124: 
125: **\"Pricing Rate\"** means the per annum percentage rate for calculating the Price Differential in respect of a Transaction, as agreed between the parties at the time the Transaction is entered into.
126: 
127: **\"Purchase Date\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the date on which the Purchased Securities are to be sold by Seller and purchased by Buyer.
128: 
129: **\"Purchase Price\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the price at which the Purchased Securities are sold by Seller and purchased by Buyer on the Purchase Date.
130: 
131: **\"Purchased Securities\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the Securities sold by Seller to Buyer on the Purchase Date, together with any New Purchased Securities transferred in substitution therefor pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 8.
132: 
133: **\"Repurchase Date\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the date on which Buyer is obliged to sell Equivalent Securities to Seller against payment of the Repurchase Price, or, in the case of an open Transaction, the date determined in accordance with Paragraph 3(c).
134: 
135: **\"Repurchase Price\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the sum of the Purchase Price and the Price Differential as at the Repurchase Date or, in the case of a Buy/Sell Back Transaction, the Sell Back Price as determined in accordance with Part 1 of Annex I.
136: 
137: **\"Sell Back Price\"** means, in respect of a Buy/Sell Back Transaction, the price at which Equivalent Securities are to be sold by Buyer to Seller on the Repurchase Date, calculated in accordance with the provisions of Part 1 of Annex I.
138: 
139: **\"Seller\"** means, in relation to any Transaction, the party that sells or agrees to sell Securities to the other party on the Purchase Date and agrees to purchase Equivalent Securities from the other party on the Repurchase Date.
140: 
141: **\"Spot Rate\"** means, in respect of any date and any pair of currencies, the prevailing spot exchange rate for the purchase of one currency with another, as determined in good faith by the party making the relevant determination, having regard to the prevailing rates quoted in the relevant foreign exchange market at or about 11:00 a.m. (London time) on such date.
142: 
143: **\"Term\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the period from (and including) the Purchase Date to (but excluding) the Repurchase Date.
144: 
145: **\"Termination\"** means the termination of a Transaction or of this Agreement in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement.
146: 
147: **\"Transaction Costs\"** means all reasonable costs, charges, fees, expenses, and other amounts (including, without limitation, legal fees and expenses, and costs of any sale or purchase of Securities) incurred by the Non-Defaulting Party by reason of, or in connection with, the enforcement of this Agreement, the exercise of its rights following an Event of Default, or the close-out of any Transaction.
148: 
149: **\"Transaction Exposure\"** has the meaning given to it in Paragraph 4(a).
150: 
151: 2.2 **Interpretive Provisions.** In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires:
152: 
153: > \(a\) references to Paragraphs, sub-paragraphs, Annexes, and Parts are references to Paragraphs, sub-paragraphs, Annexes, and Parts of or to this Agreement;
154: >
155: > \(b\) references to a Paragraph include references to each sub-paragraph thereof;
156: >
157: > \(c\) words importing the singular include the plural and vice versa;
158: >
159: > \(d\) words importing any gender include all genders;
160: >
161: > \(e\) references to any statute, regulation, directive, or other legislative provision shall be construed as a reference to such statute, regulation, directive, or provision as the same may be amended, modified, supplemented, or re-enacted from time to time;
162: >
163: > \(f\) headings are for ease of reference only and shall not affect the construction or interpretation of any provision of this Agreement; and
164: >
165: > \(g\) references to \"including\" shall mean \"including, without limitation.\"
166: 
167: **[Paragraph 3 --- Initiation; Confirmation; Termination]{.underline}**
168: 
169: **(a) Initiation.** A Transaction may be entered into between the parties on such terms as they may agree. The parties shall, before or at the time of entering into each Transaction, agree on the following terms (to the extent applicable to such Transaction):
170: 
171: > \(i\) the identity and nominal value (or quantity, as applicable) of the Purchased Securities;
172: >
173: > \(ii\) the Purchase Date;
174: >
175: > \(iii\) the Purchase Price;
176: >
177: > \(iv\) the Repurchase Date, or, if the Transaction is to be an open Transaction, a statement to that effect;
178: >
179: > \(v\) the Pricing Rate;
180: >
181: > \(vi\) the identification of each party as Buyer or Seller;
182: >
183: > \(vii\) any Margin Ratio, Margin Percentage, or other margin terms applicable to the Transaction;
184: >
185: > \(viii\) the Sell Back Price (in the case of a Buy/Sell Back Transaction); and
186: >
187: > \(ix\) such other terms as the parties may agree to be applicable to such Transaction.
188: 
189: **(b) Confirmation.** Upon entering into a Transaction, the Buyer or Seller (as the parties may agree, or, in the absence of such agreement, the Seller) shall promptly deliver to the other party a written Confirmation setting out the terms of such Transaction. Each Confirmation shall specify the relevant terms agreed under sub-paragraph (a) above and such other details as may be required for the proper recording and settlement of the Transaction. The terms of the Confirmation shall be binding on both parties unless the other party objects in writing promptly upon receipt of such Confirmation, and in any event no later than the close of business on the Business Day following receipt thereof. Failure to deliver or object to a Confirmation shall not, however, invalidate or affect the validity of the Transaction.
190: 
191: **(c) Termination of Transactions.**
192: 
193: > \(i\) Subject to the provisions of Paragraph 10, each Transaction shall terminate on the Repurchase Date upon the payment of the Repurchase Price by Seller and the delivery of Equivalent Securities by Buyer. The obligations of the parties to make such payment and delivery shall be subject to the condition that no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing in respect of either party.
194: >
195: > \(ii\) In the case of a Transaction that is an open Transaction (i.e., a Transaction for which no fixed Repurchase Date has been specified), either party may terminate such Transaction by giving notice to the other party on or before a particular Business Day, and the Transaction shall terminate on the date that is the number of Business Days\' notice agreed between the parties (or, if no such number has been agreed, two (2) Business Days) following the date of such notice. The party giving such notice shall specify in such notice the date on which the Transaction is to terminate, and such date shall be the Repurchase Date for the purposes of such Transaction.
196: 
197: **(d) Netting of Deliveries.** If on any date Transactions between the same parties call for the delivery of the same Securities by each party to the other, and if the parties have so agreed (whether in Annex II or otherwise), the delivery obligations of each party under such Transactions may be netted so that only the net deliverer shall be obliged to deliver the net amount of such Securities to the other party on such date. The scope and application of delivery netting shall be as elected or specified in Annex II.
198: 
199: **[Paragraph 4 --- Margin Maintenance]{.underline}**
200: 
201: **(a) Transaction Exposure.** The \"**Transaction Exposure**\" of a party in respect of a Transaction at any time shall be determined as follows:
202: 
203: > \(i\) if the Margin Ratio or Margin Percentage is applicable to the Transaction, the Transaction Exposure of the Buyer shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Repurchase Price at such time exceeds the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time multiplied by the Margin Ratio (or, as the case may be, the Market Value adjusted for the Margin Percentage). The Transaction Exposure of the Seller shall be the amount, if any, by which the Market Value of the Purchased Securities (adjusted as aforesaid) exceeds the Repurchase Price at such time;
204: >
205: > \(ii\) if no Margin Ratio or Margin Percentage is applicable, the Transaction Exposure of the Buyer shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Repurchase Price at such time exceeds the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time, and the Transaction Exposure of the Seller shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time exceeds the Repurchase Price at such time.
206: 
207: For the purposes of this sub-paragraph, the Repurchase Price at any time shall be the Purchase Price plus the Price Differential accrued to such time.
208: 
209: **(b) Net Exposure.** The \"**Net Exposure**\" of a party shall be determined by aggregating all Transaction Exposures of that party in respect of all outstanding Transactions between the parties, and setting off against such aggregate any Transaction Exposures of the other party, taking into account the Net Value of Margin Provided by each party. The party whose aggregate exposure (after such set-off and adjustment) is a positive amount shall be the party with the Net Exposure.
210: 
211: **(c) Margin Transfers.** If at any time one party has a Net Exposure in excess of any applicable Threshold Amount and Minimum Transfer Amount (each as specified in Annex II), such party may, by notice to the other party, require the other party to make a Margin Transfer to it in an amount sufficient to eliminate the Net Exposure (after taking into account any Threshold Amount). A Margin Transfer may be effected by:
212: 
213: > \(i\) the transfer of Cash Margin in the currency specified in Annex II or otherwise agreed; or
214: >
215: > \(ii\) the transfer of Margin Securities of a type and description acceptable to the party making the demand and falling within the categories of eligible Margin Securities specified in Annex II; or
216: >
217: > \(iii\) such combination of Cash Margin and Margin Securities as the parties may agree.
218: 
219: **(d) Valuation of Margin Securities.** For the purpose of determining the value of any Margin Securities transferred or to be transferred, such Margin Securities shall be valued at their Market Value as at the relevant date, subject to the application of any haircut or discount percentage specified in Annex II in relation to Margin Securities of that type. The value of any Margin Securities after the application of such haircut shall be the value attributed to such Margin Securities for the purposes of calculating Net Exposure.
220: 
221: **(e) Cash Margin.** Cash Margin shall be denominated in such currency as the parties may agree or as specified in Annex II. Interest shall accrue on Cash Margin at the rate and on the basis specified in Annex II, or, if no such rate is specified, at the overnight interbank rate prevailing from time to time in the principal financial centre of the currency of the Cash Margin. The party holding Cash Margin shall pay interest thereon to the party that transferred such Cash Margin in accordance with the terms elected in Annex II.
222: 
223: **(f) Return of Excess Margin.** If at any time the Net Exposure of a party to whom a Margin Transfer has been made is reduced below the Threshold Amount (if any), or if the party that previously had the Net Exposure no longer has such exposure, the party holding the excess Margin Securities or Cash Margin shall, upon demand by the other party, transfer to the other party Equivalent Margin Securities and/or Cash Margin, as the case may be, in an amount sufficient to reduce the Net Value of Margin Provided to an amount not exceeding the current Net Exposure (after taking into account any Threshold Amount and Minimum Transfer Amount).
224: 
225: **(g) Timing of Margin Transfers.** Any Margin Transfer demanded in accordance with this Paragraph 4 shall be made by the close of business on the next Business Day following the date of the demand or such other time as the parties may agree. If the parties have agreed a different settlement cycle for Margin Transfers in Annex II, such agreed cycle shall apply.
226: 
227: **(h) Disputes Regarding Margin.** If the parties disagree as to the Market Value of any Securities, Cash Margin, or the amount of any Net Exposure, they shall use reasonable efforts to resolve such disagreement in good faith. Pending resolution of any such dispute:
228: 
229: > \(i\) the party upon whom a demand has been made shall transfer the undisputed amount of margin to the other party; and
230: >
231: > \(ii\) the parties shall seek to agree upon the Market Value of the relevant Securities by reference to independent pricing sources, and, failing such agreement, by reference to quotations obtained from not fewer than two independent market-makers or dealers in the relevant Securities. The average of such quotations shall be the Market Value for the purposes of this Paragraph 4.
232: 
233: **[Paragraph 5 --- Income Payments]{.underline}**
234: 
235: **(a) Buyer\'s Obligation.** Where Income is paid in respect of any Purchased Securities during the Term of a Transaction, Buyer shall, on the relevant Income Payment Date, or on such other date as the parties may agree, pay to Seller an amount equal to the amount of such Income as would have been received by Seller had the Purchased Securities not been the subject of such Transaction.
236: 
237: **(b) Timing of Income Payment.** Unless otherwise agreed between the parties, the amount referred to in sub-paragraph (a) above shall be paid on the date on which such Income is paid in respect of the relevant Securities by the issuer or the relevant paying agent. If Income is paid on a day that is not a Business Day, payment shall be made on the next following Business Day.
238: 
239: **(c) Manufactured Payments.** Where any payment under this Paragraph 5 constitutes a \"manufactured payment\" or \"manufactured dividend\" or similar payment for tax or regulatory purposes, the following provisions shall apply:
240: 
241: > \(i\) if Buyer is required by applicable law to withhold or deduct any amount from such payment on account of tax, Buyer shall make the relevant withholding or deduction and shall pay to Seller the net amount remaining after such withholding or deduction;
242: >
243: > \(ii\) unless otherwise agreed in Annex II, Buyer shall not be required to gross up or pay any additional amounts to compensate Seller for any such withholding or deduction; and
244: >
245: > \(iii\) the parties shall cooperate in good faith to minimise any such withholding or deduction and to provide such forms, certificates, or documentation as may be reasonably required by applicable law or regulation.
246: 
247: **(d) Set-off of Income.** Buyer may set off any amount due from Buyer to Seller under this Paragraph 5 against any amount due from Seller to Buyer under any Transaction, provided that both amounts are due and payable on the same date and are denominated in the same currency.
248: 
249: **(e) Buy/Sell Back Transactions.** In the case of Buy/Sell Back Transactions, the treatment of Income shall be as provided in Part 1 of Annex I. The Sell Back Price shall be adjusted to reflect any Income received or receivable during the Term, in accordance with the formula set out in Part 1 of Annex I, and the provisions of this Paragraph 5 shall apply only to the extent specified in Annex I and subject to any elections made in Annex II.

lines.text: **[2011 ICMA GLOBAL MASTER REPURCHASE AGREEMENT]{.underline}**
**Standard Form**
Published by the International Capital Market Association (ICMA)
**GLOBAL MASTER REPURCHASE AGREEMENT**

**WHEREAS**, Party A and Party B wish to enter into repurchase transactions, buy/sell back transactions, and such other transactions as the parties may agree from time to time, each such transaction to be governed by and subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement;

**WHEREAS**, the parties acknowledge and agree that this Agreement, together with Annex I (Supplemental Terms and Conditions), Annex II (Elections and Variables), and any Confirmations exchanged between the parties relating to individual Transactions, shall together constitute a single agreement between the parties (collectively referred to as this \"**Agreement**\"), and the parties would not otherwise enter into any Transaction;

**NOW, THEREFORE**, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:
**[Paragraph 1 --- Applicability]{.underline}**

1.1 This Agreement shall govern each Transaction entered into between Party A and Party B on or after the date of this Agreement. Each transaction that the parties agree shall be governed by this Agreement shall constitute a \"**Transaction**\" for the purposes of this Agreement from the date upon which the parties agree to enter into such Transaction.

1.2 The terms of each Confirmation relating to a Transaction are hereby incorporated by reference into, and shall be supplemental to and form part of, this Agreement. Each Confirmation shall be read and construed together with this Agreement as a single instrument.

1.3 In the event of any inconsistency between the terms of any Confirmation, Annex II (Elections and Variables), Annex I (Supplemental Terms and Conditions), and the printed paragraphs of this Agreement, the following order of precedence shall apply:
> \(a\) first, the terms of the relevant Confirmation;
> \(b\) second, the terms of Annex II (Elections and Variables);
> \(c\) third, the terms of Annex I (Supplemental Terms and Conditions); and
> \(d\) fourth, the printed paragraphs of this Agreement.
1.4 Nothing in this Agreement shall require either party to enter into any Transaction with the other party. Each Transaction shall be entered into on such terms as the parties may agree at the time.
**[Paragraph 2 --- Definitions]{.underline}**
2.1 In this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:
**\"Act of Insolvency\"** means, in respect of either party, any of the following:

> \(a\) the filing by such party of a petition or the commencement of any case or proceeding under any bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganisation, administration, moratorium, composition, adjustment of debts, liquidation, dissolution, winding-up, or similar law of any jurisdiction, whether now or hereafter in effect, seeking the entry of an order for relief or the adjudication of such party as bankrupt or insolvent, or seeking reorganisation, arrangement, adjustment, winding-up, liquidation, dissolution, composition, or other relief with respect to such party or its debts;

> \(b\) the filing of any such petition or the commencement of any such case or proceeding against such party that (i) results in a judgment of insolvency or bankruptcy, the entry of an order for relief, or the making of an order for the winding-up or liquidation of such party, or (ii) is not dismissed, discharged, stayed, or restrained within the period specified in Annex II, or, if no such period is specified, within thirty (30) calendar days of the institution or presentation thereof;

> \(c\) the seeking by such party of the appointment of an administrator, provisional liquidator, conservator, receiver, trustee, custodian, or other similar official for such party or for all or substantially all of its assets;
> \(d\) the appointment of an administrator, provisional liquidator, conservator, receiver, trustee, custodian, or other similar official for such party or for all or substantially all of its assets;
> \(e\) the making by such party of a general assignment, arrangement, scheme, or composition with or for the benefit of its creditors;
> \(f\) the admission by such party, in writing or otherwise, of its inability to pay its debts as they become due or as they fall due;

> \(g\) the taking of any corporate action, the passing of any resolution, or the making of any application to a court of competent jurisdiction by such party for the purpose of effecting or seeking any of the foregoing;
> \(h\) the imposition by any governmental, regulatory, or supervisory authority of a moratorium with respect to payments by such party; or
> \(i\) any analogous event or proceeding in any jurisdiction.

**\"Agency Transaction\"** means a Transaction entered into by a party acting as agent on behalf of one or more identified or unidentified principals, subject to the provisions of Part 2 of Annex I (Agency Transactions) and the elections made in Annex II.

**\"Appropriate Market\"** means, in relation to any Securities, a market determined in accordance with prevailing market practice for securities of the same type, currency of denomination, and characteristics as the relevant Securities.
**\"Base Currency\"** means the currency specified as such in Part 1 of Annex II.

**\"Business Day\"** means a day (other than a Saturday or Sunday) on which commercial banks and foreign exchange markets are open for general business (including dealings in foreign exchange and foreign currency deposits) in the place or places specified in Annex II as relevant to the performance of the relevant obligation, or, if no such place is specified, in the place or places relevant to the settlement of the relevant Transaction as determined in accordance with market practice.
**\"Buy/Sell Back Transaction\"** means a Transaction of the type described in, and which is subject to, the provisions of Part 1 of Annex I (Buy/Sell Back Transactions) applicable thereto.

**\"Cash Equivalent Investments\"** means investments in such instruments as may be specified or defined in Annex II, or, if no such instruments are specified or defined, investments in overnight deposits in the Base Currency with creditworthy deposit-taking institutions.
**\"Cash Margin\"** means cash transferred as margin pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 4.

**\"Close-out Date\"** means the date designated as such in a Default Notice, being the date on which all outstanding Transactions between the parties are terminated following the occurrence of an Event of Default, or, in the case of automatic Early Termination upon an Act of Insolvency, the date on which such termination occurs automatically.

**\"Confirmation\"** means the written confirmation, the exchange of electronic messages, or other agreed form of communication evidencing the agreement of the parties to the terms of a Transaction, and setting out the specific terms of such Transaction.

**\"Contractual Currency\"** means, in respect of any payment obligation arising under this Agreement or any Transaction, the currency in which such payment is denominated or otherwise required to be made.

**\"Default Market Value\"** means, in respect of any Equivalent Securities or Purchased Securities that are the subject of a terminated Transaction, the market value of such securities determined in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 10.
**\"Default Notice\"** means a notice served by the Non-Defaulting Party pursuant to Paragraph 10, designating that an Event of Default has occurred and specifying a Close-out Date.
**\"Defaulting Party\"** means the party in respect of which an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.
**\"Deliverable Securities\"** means the Securities to be delivered by Seller to Buyer on the Purchase Date of a Transaction.

**\"Distributions\"** means all dividends, interest payments, principal repayments, redemption proceeds, and any other payments, distributions, or deliveries of any kind whatsoever paid, made, or received in respect of Securities, whether in cash, in kind, or otherwise, including, without limitation, any rights, warrants, or other entitlements arising in respect of such Securities.

**\"Equivalent Margin Securities\"** means securities equivalent to Margin Securities previously transferred pursuant to Paragraph 4, being securities of the same issuer, part of the same issue, and of an identical type, nominal value, description, and amount as the relevant Margin Securities.

**\"Equivalent Securities\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, securities equivalent to the Purchased Securities under that Transaction. Securities are \"equivalent to\" other securities for these purposes if they are: (a) of the same issuer; (b) part of the same issue; (c) of an identical type, nominal value, description, and amount; and (d) equivalent in all material respects. Where Purchased Securities have been redeemed, converted, exchanged, or subdivided, or any rights, warrants, or other entitlements have arisen in respect thereof, \"Equivalent Securities\" shall include, as appropriate, the resulting securities, rights, entitlements, and proceeds.
**\"Event of Default\"** means any of the events specified in Paragraph 10(a).

**\"Income\"** means any Distributions in the form of dividends, interest, or other periodic payments in respect of any Purchased Securities during the Term of a Transaction, but shall not include any redemption proceeds or principal repayments, unless otherwise agreed in Annex II.
**\"Income Payment Date\"** means, in respect of any Purchased Securities, the date on which Income is paid or distributed in respect of such Securities by the issuer or relevant paying agent.
**\"ICMA\"** means the International Capital Market Association.

**\"Margin Percentage\"** means the percentage agreed between the parties in relation to a Transaction, or, if no such percentage is agreed, the percentage specified in Annex II for the relevant category of Purchased Securities.

**\"Margin Ratio\"** means the ratio agreed between the parties in relation to a Transaction, or, if no such ratio is agreed, the ratio specified in Annex II for the relevant category of Purchased Securities.
**\"Margin Securities\"** means Securities transferred by way of margin pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 4.
**\"Margin Transfer\"** means any transfer of Cash Margin or Margin Securities pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 4.

**\"Market Value\"** means, in respect of any Securities on any particular date, the price obtained from a generally recognised pricing source in the Appropriate Market for securities of the same description, or, if no such price is available, the most recently available closing bid price quotation from such source. If no such pricing source or quotation is available, Market Value shall be determined in good faith by the parties having regard to prevailing market conditions and the characteristics of the relevant Securities, and, in the event of disagreement, as determined in accordance with Paragraph 4(h).
**\"Net Exposure\"** has the meaning given to it in Paragraph 4(b).
**\"Net Margin\"** has the meaning given to it in Paragraph 4.
**\"Net Paying Party\"** means the party that, following the close-out calculation under Paragraph 10, has a net obligation to make payment to the other party.

**\"Net Value of Margin Provided\"** means, in respect of any party, the aggregate Market Value of all Margin Securities transferred by that party to the other party and not yet returned, plus the aggregate amount of all Cash Margin transferred by that party to the other party and not yet returned, less the aggregate Market Value of all Equivalent Margin Securities returned to that party and less the aggregate amount of all Cash Margin returned to that party.
**\"New Purchased Securities\"** means securities substituted for original Purchased Securities in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 8.
**\"Non-Defaulting Party\"** means the party that is not the Defaulting Party.

**\"Price Differential\"** means, in respect of any Transaction and as at any date, the aggregate amount of interest that has accrued on the Purchase Price from (and including) the Purchase Date to (but excluding) the date of calculation, computed on the basis of the Pricing Rate agreed for that Transaction and the day count convention applicable to such Pricing Rate.
**\"Pricing Rate\"** means the per annum percentage rate for calculating the Price Differential in respect of a Transaction, as agreed between the parties at the time the Transaction is entered into.
**\"Purchase Date\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the date on which the Purchased Securities are to be sold by Seller and purchased by Buyer.
**\"Purchase Price\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the price at which the Purchased Securities are sold by Seller and purchased by Buyer on the Purchase Date.

**\"Purchased Securities\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the Securities sold by Seller to Buyer on the Purchase Date, together with any New Purchased Securities transferred in substitution therefor pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 8.

**\"Repurchase Date\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the date on which Buyer is obliged to sell Equivalent Securities to Seller against payment of the Repurchase Price, or, in the case of an open Transaction, the date determined in accordance with Paragraph 3(c).

**\"Repurchase Price\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the sum of the Purchase Price and the Price Differential as at the Repurchase Date or, in the case of a Buy/Sell Back Transaction, the Sell Back Price as determined in accordance with Part 1 of Annex I.

**\"Sell Back Price\"** means, in respect of a Buy/Sell Back Transaction, the price at which Equivalent Securities are to be sold by Buyer to Seller on the Repurchase Date, calculated in accordance with the provisions of Part 1 of Annex I.

**\"Seller\"** means, in relation to any Transaction, the party that sells or agrees to sell Securities to the other party on the Purchase Date and agrees to purchase Equivalent Securities from the other party on the Repurchase Date.

**\"Spot Rate\"** means, in respect of any date and any pair of currencies, the prevailing spot exchange rate for the purchase of one currency with another, as determined in good faith by the party making the relevant determination, having regard to the prevailing rates quoted in the relevant foreign exchange market at or about 11:00 a.m. (London time) on such date.
**\"Term\"** means, in respect of any Transaction, the period from (and including) the Purchase Date to (but excluding) the Repurchase Date.
**\"Termination\"** means the termination of a Transaction or of this Agreement in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement.

**\"Transaction Costs\"** means all reasonable costs, charges, fees, expenses, and other amounts (including, without limitation, legal fees and expenses, and costs of any sale or purchase of Securities) incurred by the Non-Defaulting Party by reason of, or in connection with, the enforcement of this Agreement, the exercise of its rights following an Event of Default, or the close-out of any Transaction.
**\"Transaction Exposure\"** has the meaning given to it in Paragraph 4(a).
2.2 **Interpretive Provisions.** In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires:
> \(a\) references to Paragraphs, sub-paragraphs, Annexes, and Parts are references to Paragraphs, sub-paragraphs, Annexes, and Parts of or to this Agreement;
> \(b\) references to a Paragraph include references to each sub-paragraph thereof;
> \(c\) words importing the singular include the plural and vice versa;
> \(d\) words importing any gender include all genders;

> \(e\) references to any statute, regulation, directive, or other legislative provision shall be construed as a reference to such statute, regulation, directive, or provision as the same may be amended, modified, supplemented, or re-enacted from time to time;
> \(f\) headings are for ease of reference only and shall not affect the construction or interpretation of any provision of this Agreement; and
> \(g\) references to \"including\" shall mean \"including, without limitation.\"
**[Paragraph 3 --- Initiation; Confirmation; Termination]{.underline}**

**(a) Initiation.** A Transaction may be entered into between the parties on such terms as they may agree. The parties shall, before or at the time of entering into each Transaction, agree on the following terms (to the extent applicable to such Transaction):
> \(i\) the identity and nominal value (or quantity, as applicable) of the Purchased Securities;
> \(ii\) the Purchase Date;
> \(iii\) the Purchase Price;
> \(iv\) the Repurchase Date, or, if the Transaction is to be an open Transaction, a statement to that effect;
> \(v\) the Pricing Rate;
> \(vi\) the identification of each party as Buyer or Seller;
> \(vii\) any Margin Ratio, Margin Percentage, or other margin terms applicable to the Transaction;
> \(viii\) the Sell Back Price (in the case of a Buy/Sell Back Transaction); and
> \(ix\) such other terms as the parties may agree to be applicable to such Transaction.

**(b) Confirmation.** Upon entering into a Transaction, the Buyer or Seller (as the parties may agree, or, in the absence of such agreement, the Seller) shall promptly deliver to the other party a written Confirmation setting out the terms of such Transaction. Each Confirmation shall specify the relevant terms agreed under sub-paragraph (a) above and such other details as may be required for the proper recording and settlement of the Transaction. The terms of the Confirmation shall be binding on both parties unless the other party objects in writing promptly upon receipt of such Confirmation, and in any event no later than the close of business on the Business Day following receipt thereof. Failure to deliver or object to a Confirmation shall not, however, invalidate or affect the validity of the Transaction.
**(c) Termination of Transactions.**

> \(i\) Subject to the provisions of Paragraph 10, each Transaction shall terminate on the Repurchase Date upon the payment of the Repurchase Price by Seller and the delivery of Equivalent Securities by Buyer. The obligations of the parties to make such payment and delivery shall be subject to the condition that no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing in respect of either party.

> \(ii\) In the case of a Transaction that is an open Transaction (i.e., a Transaction for which no fixed Repurchase Date has been specified), either party may terminate such Transaction by giving notice to the other party on or before a particular Business Day, and the Transaction shall terminate on the date that is the number of Business Days\' notice agreed between the parties (or, if no such number has been agreed, two (2) Business Days) following the date of such notice. The party giving such notice shall specify in such notice the date on which the Transaction is to terminate, and such date shall be the Repurchase Date for the purposes of such Transaction.

**(d) Netting of Deliveries.** If on any date Transactions between the same parties call for the delivery of the same Securities by each party to the other, and if the parties have so agreed (whether in Annex II or otherwise), the delivery obligations of each party under such Transactions may be netted so that only the net deliverer shall be obliged to deliver the net amount of such Securities to the other party on such date. The scope and application of delivery netting shall be as elected or specified in Annex II.
**[Paragraph 4 --- Margin Maintenance]{.underline}**
**(a) Transaction Exposure.** The \"**Transaction Exposure**\" of a party in respect of a Transaction at any time shall be determined as follows:

> \(i\) if the Margin Ratio or Margin Percentage is applicable to the Transaction, the Transaction Exposure of the Buyer shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Repurchase Price at such time exceeds the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time multiplied by the Margin Ratio (or, as the case may be, the Market Value adjusted for the Margin Percentage). The Transaction Exposure of the Seller shall be the amount, if any, by which the Market Value of the Purchased Securities (adjusted as aforesaid) exceeds the Repurchase Price at such time;

> \(ii\) if no Margin Ratio or Margin Percentage is applicable, the Transaction Exposure of the Buyer shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Repurchase Price at such time exceeds the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time, and the Transaction Exposure of the Seller shall equal the amount, if any, by which the Market Value of the Purchased Securities at such time exceeds the Repurchase Price at such time.
For the purposes of this sub-paragraph, the Repurchase Price at any time shall be the Purchase Price plus the Price Differential accrued to such time.

**(b) Net Exposure.** The \"**Net Exposure**\" of a party shall be determined by aggregating all Transaction Exposures of that party in respect of all outstanding Transactions between the parties, and setting off against such aggregate any Transaction Exposures of the other party, taking into account the Net Value of Margin Provided by each party. The party whose aggregate exposure (after such set-off and adjustment) is a positive amount shall be the party with the Net Exposure.

**(c) Margin Transfers.** If at any time one party has a Net Exposure in excess of any applicable Threshold Amount and Minimum Transfer Amount (each as specified in Annex II), such party may, by notice to the other party, require the other party to make a Margin Transfer to it in an amount sufficient to eliminate the Net Exposure (after taking into account any Threshold Amount). A Margin Transfer may be effected by:
> \(i\) the transfer of Cash Margin in the currency specified in Annex II or otherwise agreed; or

> \(ii\) the transfer of Margin Securities of a type and description acceptable to the party making the demand and falling within the categories of eligible Margin Securities specified in Annex II; or
> \(iii\) such combination of Cash Margin and Margin Securities as the parties may agree.

**(d) Valuation of Margin Securities.** For the purpose of determining the value of any Margin Securities transferred or to be transferred, such Margin Securities shall be valued at their Market Value as at the relevant date, subject to the application of any haircut or discount percentage specified in Annex II in relation to Margin Securities of that type. The value of any Margin Securities after the application of such haircut shall be the value attributed to such Margin Securities for the purposes of calculating Net Exposure.

**(e) Cash Margin.** Cash Margin shall be denominated in such currency as the parties may agree or as specified in Annex II. Interest shall accrue on Cash Margin at the rate and on the basis specified in Annex II, or, if no such rate is specified, at the overnight interbank rate prevailing from time to time in the principal financial centre of the currency of the Cash Margin. The party holding Cash Margin shall pay interest thereon to the party that transferred such Cash Margin in accordance with the terms elected in Annex II.

**(f) Return of Excess Margin.** If at any time the Net Exposure of a party to whom a Margin Transfer has been made is reduced below the Threshold Amount (if any), or if the party that previously had the Net Exposure no longer has such exposure, the party holding the excess Margin Securities or Cash Margin shall, upon demand by the other party, transfer to the other party Equivalent Margin Securities and/or Cash Margin, as the case may be, in an amount sufficient to reduce the Net Value of Margin Provided to an amount not exceeding the current Net Exposure (after taking into account any Threshold Amount and Minimum Transfer Amount).

**(g) Timing of Margin Transfers.** Any Margin Transfer demanded in accordance with this Paragraph 4 shall be made by the close of business on the next Business Day following the date of the demand or such other time as the parties may agree. If the parties have agreed a different settlement cycle for Margin Transfers in Annex II, such agreed cycle shall apply.

**(h) Disputes Regarding Margin.** If the parties disagree as to the Market Value of any Securities, Cash Margin, or the amount of any Net Exposure, they shall use reasonable efforts to resolve such disagreement in good faith. Pending resolution of any such dispute:
> \(i\) the party upon whom a demand has been made shall transfer the undisputed amount of margin to the other party; and

> \(ii\) the parties shall seek to agree upon the Market Value of the relevant Securities by reference to independent pricing sources, and, failing such agreement, by reference to quotations obtained from not fewer than two independent market-makers or dealers in the relevant Securities. The average of such quotations shall be the Market Value for the purposes of this Paragraph 4.
**[Paragraph 5 --- Income Payments]{.underline}**

**(a) Buyer\'s Obligation.** Where Income is paid in respect of any Purchased Securities during the Term of a Transaction, Buyer shall, on the relevant Income Payment Date, or on such other date as the parties may agree, pay to Seller an amount equal to the amount of such Income as would have been received by Seller had the Purchased Securities not been the subject of such Transaction.

**(b) Timing of Income Payment.** Unless otherwise agreed between the parties, the amount referred to in sub-paragraph (a) above shall be paid on the date on which such Income is paid in respect of the relevant Securities by the issuer or the relevant paying agent. If Income is paid on a day that is not a Business Day, payment shall be made on the next following Business Day.

**(c) Manufactured Payments.** Where any payment under this Paragraph 5 constitutes a \"manufactured payment\" or \"manufactured dividend\" or similar payment for tax or regulatory purposes, the following provisions shall apply:

> \(i\) if Buyer is required by applicable law to withhold or deduct any amount from such payment on account of tax, Buyer shall make the relevant withholding or deduction and shall pay to Seller the net amount remaining after such withholding or deduction;
> \(ii\) unless otherwise agreed in Annex II, Buyer shall not be required to gross up or pay any additional amounts to compensate Seller for any such withholding or deduction; and

> \(iii\) the parties shall cooperate in good faith to minimise any such withholding or deduction and to provide such forms, certificates, or documentation as may be reasonably required by applicable law or regulation.

**(d) Set-off of Income.** Buyer may set off any amount due from Buyer to Seller under this Paragraph 5 against any amount due from Seller to Buyer under any Transaction, provided that both amounts are due and payable on the same date and are denominated in the same currency.

**(e) Buy/Sell Back Transactions.** In the case of Buy/Sell Back Transactions, the treatment of Income shall be as provided in Part 1 of Annex I. The Sell Back Price shall be adjusted to reflect any Income received or receivable during the Term, in accordance with the formula set out in Part 1 of Annex I, and the provisions of this Paragraph 5 shall apply only to the extent specified in Annex I and subject to any elections made in Annex II.

13: This document contains privileged and confidential attorney-client communications and work product prepared by and at the direction of the Office of General Counsel of Meridian Capital Securities LLC. It is intended exclusively for use by authorized personnel of Meridian Capital Securities LLC and Meridian\'s approved outside counsel in connection with the negotiation of repurchase agreement documentation. Any unauthorized disclosure, reproduction, or distribution of this document or its contents is strictly prohibited and may constitute a waiver of applicable privileges. If you have received this document in error, please notify the Office of General Counsel immediately at (212) 555-0147 and destroy all copies in your possession.
